V. 14.
This Goſpel ſhall be preached in all the world—Not univerſally; This is not done yet: But in general, thro' the ſeveral Parts of the World, and not only in Jude•. And this was done by St. Paut and the other Apoſtles, before Jeruſalem was deſtroyed. And then ſhall the end come—Of the City and Temple.

Joſephus's Hiſtory of the Jewiſh war, is the beſt Commentary on this Chapter. It is a wonderful Inſtance of GOD's Providence that he, an Eye-witneſs, and one who lived and died a Iew, ſhould (eſpecially in ſo extraordinary a Manner) be preſerved, to tranſmit to us a Collection of important Facts, which ſo exactly illuſtrate this glorious Prophecy, in almoſt every Circumſtance
